added_sample: Webform Submissions Delete - Moderately critical - Access bypass - SA-CONTRIB-2026-133
removed_sample: Slick Carousel - Moderately critical - Cross Site Scripting - SA-CONTRIB-2026-117
Slick UI, a sub-module of Slick, enables you to add Slick option sets that may contain HTML for carousel buttons.
Previous releases of the module did not sufficiently validate user input, leading to a Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability.

review.note: Rolling SA-CONTRIB advisory feed rotation: SA-CONTRIB-2026-133 (Webform Submissions Delete, moderately critical access bypass, 2026-September-02) entered the window and SA-CONTRIB-2026-117 (Slick Carousel XSS) left it. The referencing reviewed record (drupal.security.advisory-streams-separated) claims core, contrib and PSA advisories are distinct streams with different roles; every observed entry remains SA-CONTRIB-prefixed, so that claim is unaffected. Drupal Knowledge holds no per-advisory records to revise: systematic advisory modelling is scoped to a later roadmap epic, not a revision of existing knowledge.
